# codencode.sg

> codencode.sg is a Singapore AI academy. Learn AI. Build AI. Lead with AI. It offers a 6-level, project-based AI learning pathway (CC-AI01 AI Explorer to CC-AI06 AI Leader) and corporate AI programmes for teams. Classes are live and taught in English, Mandarin (中文) and Bahasa Melayu, with Tamil-speaking support. First class is free.

Last updated: 2026-10-23

## 6-level AI pathway
Progression: Use AI → Code AI → Build AI → Deploy AI → Lead AI Projects. Each level combines guided instruction, practical labs, assessment and a portfolio-ready capstone.
- CC-AI01 AI Explorer — Foundation. Understand AI and use generative AI responsibly and effectively. Capstone: AI-powered learning assistant, idea generator or simple interactive mini project. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Explorer.
- CC-AI02 AI Creator — Creator. Use Python and AI-assisted tools to create useful digital products. Capstone: AI study assistant, quiz generator, travel planner or content workflow tool. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Creator.
- CC-AI03 AI Developer — Application Development. Build AI applications using APIs, databases and introductory RAG. Capstone: Company knowledge assistant: upload documents, retrieve relevant information and answer grounded questions. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Developer.
- CC-AI04 AI Builder — Machine Learning. Apply machine learning and computer vision to real datasets and problems. Capstone: Defect detection, customer prediction, component recognition or another domain-specific ML solution. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Builder.
- CC-AI05 AI Engineer — Production AI. Design and deploy production-style LLM, RAG and agent systems. Capstone: Production-style customer service, internal knowledge or workflow automation platform. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Engineer.
- CC-AI06 AI Leader — Industry Capstone. Lead a real industry AI project from problem definition to presentation. Capstone: Real industry capstone: problem → proposal → data → prototype → testing → presentation → deployment roadmap. Certification: CodenCode Certified AI Leader.

## Assessment
- Practical exercises and lab completion.
- A graded capstone or applied project at every level.
- Portfolio evidence from Level 2 onward.
- Code review, demonstration or presentation at advanced levels.
- Attendance and participation requirements defined for each cohort.

## Corporate AI programmes
Formats: 4-hour Discovery Workshop (Awareness, use-case discovery and practical introduction); 8-hour Hands-on Training (Guided practice with role-specific workflows and exercises); 2-day Business Automation Bootcamp (Workflow mapping, prototyping and automation design); Private / Custom Team Training (Content adapted to department, industry and internal use cases); Implementation Support (Separately scoped support after training for prototypes or workflow rollout).
- AI for Workplace — for employees and cross-functional teams. Outcome: Participants leave with reusable workflows and prompt patterns for recurring workplace tasks.
- AI for Managers & C-Suites — for managers, department heads and senior leadership. Outcome: A prioritised AI opportunity map and initial adoption roadmap.
- AI for Human Resources — for hr, recruitment and people operations teams. Outcome: A set of practical HR workflows and a prototype HR knowledge or onboarding assistant.
- AI for Marketing — for marketing, sales support, content and communications teams. Outcome: A repeatable AI-assisted marketing workflow plus campaign/content assets.
- AI for Content & Video Creation — for marketing teams, creators and communications staff. Outcome: A small portfolio of AI-assisted content and a repeatable production workflow.
- AI for Business & Automation — for business owners, smes, operations and process owners. Outcome: A mapped business process and working automation or application prototype.
